author: nickyeow

english.text: You had better go to bed right away, or your cold will get worse.

jyutping: nei5 dou1 hai6 faai3 di1 heoi3 fan3 laa1，jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 di1 gam2 mou6 zau6 wui5 jyu6 lai4 jyu6 ging6 gaa3 laa1。
text: 你都係快啲去瞓啦，如果唔係啲感冒就會愈嚟愈勁㗎啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It was not until three days after that I knew she had disappeared.

jyutping: gwo3 zo2 saam1 jat6 ngo5 sin1 zi1 jyun4 loi4 keoi5 sat1 zo2 zung1。
text: 過咗三日我先知原來佢失咗蹤。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The work over, we went home.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou6 jyun4 je5 zau6 faan2 zo2 uk1 kei2。
text: 我哋做完嘢就返咗屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You don't need to worry about it.

jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1。
text: 你唔使擔心。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't remember how to say "Thank you" in German.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 m4 hei2「do1 ze6」jung6 dak1 man4 dim2 gong2。
text: 我諗唔起「多謝」用德文點講。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is always giving presents to his wife.

jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sung3 lai5 mat6 bei2 lou5 po4。
text: 佢成日都送禮物俾老婆。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If only I were as handsome as he is.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 jau5 keoi5 gam3 leng3 zai2 zau6 hou2 laa3。
text: 如果我有佢咁靚仔就好喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Now that you mention it, I don't remember seeing Tom in class today.

jyutping: gong2 haa2 gong2 haa2 gam1 jat6 aa3 Tom hou2 ci5 zan1 hai6 mou5 faan1 hok6 wo3。
text: 講吓講吓今日阿 Tom 好似真係冇返學喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you like eating fish?

jyutping: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 jyu4 gaa3？
text: 你鍾唔鍾意食魚㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't want to live on this planet anymore.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 sang1 cyun4 hai2 ni1 go3 sing1 kau4 soeng6 laa3。
text: 我唔想再生存喺呢個星球上喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't people tell you you look like Audrey Hepburn?

jyutping: mat1 di1 jan4 mou5 tung4 nei5 gong2 waa6 nei5 hou2 ci5 Audrey Hepburn me1？
text: 乜啲人冇同你講話你好似Audrey Hepburn咩？

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm going to bring Tom some dinner.

jyutping: ngo5 daai3 di1 je5 bei2 Tom sik6 je6 maan5。
text: 我帶啲嘢俾Tom食夜晚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I started working for this company last year.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng6 nin2 hoi1 ci2 bong1 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5。
text: 我上年開始幫呢間公司做嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's always been kind to me.

jyutping: keoi5 jat1 lou6 dou1 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2。
text: 佢一路都對我好好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Your new hair style makes you look older.

jyutping: nei5 go3 san1 faat3 jing4 mong6 lok6 hou2 ci5 lou5 zo2。
text: 你個新髮型望落好似老咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Am I pronouncing your name correctly?

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 duk6 co3 nei5 go3 ming4 aa3 ho2？
text: 我冇讀錯你個名呀可？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He was disappointed at not being invited.

jyutping: mou5 jan2 cing2 keoi5 heoi3，so2 ji5 keoi5 hou2 sat1 mong6。
text: 冇人請佢去，所以佢好失望。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When you stand so close to death, knowing that it will not touch you, you feel something special!

jyutping: dong1 nei5 tung4 sei2 mong4 zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 jat1 sin3 zi1 gaak3，daan6 hai6 nei5 jau6 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dim3 m4 dou3 nei5，nei5 wui5 jau5 jat1 zung2 hou2 dak6 bit6 ge3 gam2 gok3！
text: 當你同死亡只不過係一線之隔，但係你又知道佢掂唔到你，你會有一種好特別嘅感覺！

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is constantly complaining.

jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou2 jyun3 ne1 joeng2 jyun3 go2 joeng2。
text: 佢成日都喺到怨呢樣怨嗰樣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where can I buy a bathing suit?

jyutping: bin1 dou6 jau5 dak1 maai5 juk6 pou4 aa3？
text: 邊度有得買浴袍呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you're sick, then go see the doctor!

jyutping: jau5 beng6 zau6 tai2 ji1 sang1 laa1！
text: 有病就睇醫生啦！

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 4th of September of 2013. For Centralia, my main recommendation is Esperanto. I believe that it could strengthen people there. It has something to do with mouth movements, respiration, etc. Also, its simplicity is better. It is more Daoistic. Lojban in Centralia would be for top students only because it is like learning weird mathematics. Lojban words are like Japanese Kanji because they have different sounds when they combine. The root words have shorter forms in combinations.

jyutping: hai2 2013 nin4 9 jyut6 4 hou6。deoi3 jyu1 zung1 waan4，ngo5 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 teoi1 zin3 hai6 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，ngo5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 ho2 ji5 gaa1 koeng4 go2 dou6 ge3 jan4。tung4 maai4，keoi5 ge3 gaan2 daan1 sing3 gang3 hou2。keoi5 hai2 zung1 waan4 ge3 Lojban wui5 bei2 gaau3 dou6 gaau3，zi2 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 hou2 ci5 hok6 gan2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 sou3 hok6 gam2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 zou2 hap6 go2 zan6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 sing1 jam1。
text: 喺2013年9月4號。對於中環，我嘅主要推薦係世界語，我相信佢可以加強嗰度嘅人。同埋，佢嘅簡單性更好。佢喺中環嘅 Lojban 會比較道教，只係因為佢好似學緊奇怪嘅數學噉，因為佢哋組合嗰陣有唔同嘅聲音。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 4th of March of 2015. In religious discussions with other people and in readings, I have learnt different scenarios about the spirit-soul. Some say that the spirit is different from the soul. Some say that the body is the soul. Some say that there is neither soul nor spirit, but there is a fluid consciousness stream. Some say that there are multiple souls or spirits inside or outside the body.

jyutping: hai6 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 4 hou6。hai2 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 zung1 gaau3 tou2 leon6 tung4 duk6 syu1 zung1，ngo5 hok6 dou3 m4 tung4 ge3 gwaan1 jyu1 ling4 wan4 ge3 coeng4 ging2。jau5 jan4 waa2 zing1 san4 tung4 ling4 wan4 m4 tung4。jau5 jan4 waa2 san1 tai2 zau6 hai6 ling4 wan4。jau5 jan4 waa2 ge3 mou5 ling4 wan4，jik6 mou5 ling4 wan4，daan6 hai6 jau5 jat1 tiu4 lau4 dung6 ge3 ji3 sik1 lau4。jau5 jan4 waa2 san1 tai2 jap6 min6 waak6 ze2 san1 tai2 ngoi6 min6 dou1 jau5 do1 go3 ling4 wan4 waak6 ze2 ling4 wan4。
text: 係2015年3月4號。喺同其他人嘅宗教討論同讀書中，我學到唔同嘅關於靈魂嘅場景。有人話精神同靈魂唔同。有人話身體就係靈魂。有人話嘅冇靈魂，亦冇靈魂，但係有一條流動嘅意識流。有人話身體入面或者身體外面都有多個靈魂或者靈魂。
